components.description: Unpaid parental leave of up to six months for a faculty member who becomes a biological parent, has a child placed pending adoption, or has significant care responsibilities for a newborn, adopted or foster child; paid leave (own accruals, the advanced-leave Paid Parental Leave Program) may be used within it.
components.faculty_group_note: CBA Art. 35: 'faculty member' means a member of the bargaining unit; Appendix A lists Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor among the positions included; the tenure probationary periods in 19.3(b) cover the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences and the College of Engineering.
components.eligible_parent_wording: becomes a biological parent; a child is placed in the faculty member’s home pending adoption; significant care responsibilities for a newborn, a newly adopted child, or a child received into a licensed family foster home; legal guardian

components.time_window: may begin two weeks before the expected date of the child's arrival (Reg 1.201(13)(a); HR pages); the HR FMLA page adds that it must occur before the child's first birthday
components.notice: a leave of one semester or more requires a written request not less than 120 days before it begins (CBA 21.3(a)); the period is set in consultation with the University (21.7(c))

notes: Sources: 2018_01 CBA; 2018_02 Reg 1.201; 2018_05 Reg 7.019; 2018_06 HR FMLA page; 2018_07 leave chart; 2018_08 PPL procedure; 2018_09 MOU; 2018_10 tenure-extension form.

Governing document: the 2017-2019 UF BOT-UFF collective bargaining agreement (effective 2017-01-01 to 2019-12-31) with its signed MOU of 14 Dec 2016 (Art. 33.4 makes memoranda part of the agreement). Its bargaining unit (Art. 35, Appendix A) includes Assistant, Associate and full Professors, and Art. 19.3(b) sets probationary periods for Liberal Arts and Sciences and Engineering, so the member described (main-campus tenure-stream, two years' service) is a unit member and the CBA path is coded (U8).

Other path (U8): Reg 1.201 governs employees outside the bargaining unit; CBA 8.3 says no regulation applies to unit faculty where it conflicts with the agreement, and the HR PPL procedure (2018_08) limits its paid parental leave to 'Faculty (non-UFF), TEAMS, and USPS'. Non-unit terms, recorded here and not as components: Reg 1.201(13)(a) six months unpaid parental leave (also for a domestic partner of an expected parent; may begin two weeks before arrival); (13)(b) up to 6 weeks of advanced sick or vacation leave repaid within 3 years (HR procedure: both UF parents eligible; the other parent may repay); (14) up to 6 months medical/family leave, 'may be granted', extendable to 1 year; (15) up to 12 months LWOP for personal reasons, 'may be granted'; (20)(b)1 faculty LWOP up to 1 year, 'shall grant ... unless'; Reg 7.019(3)(c) one-year probationary extension for a new child or seriously ill family member ('shall be granted'), extraordinary-circumstance extension on request, two-year maximum; 7.019(3)(b)5 leave semesters not counted. Where Reg 1.201 and the CBA agree (six-month parental leave, two-week pre-arrival start, part-time work during the leave), the Regulation is cited on the CBA-path components.

Conflict (source precedence): the HR FMLA page (2018_06, captured 2018-03-03) describes the paid parental leave as up to 6 weeks for faculty, with unit faculty repaying over 6 years; the signed MOU raises the unit faculty's paid parental leave to 12 weeks. The governing CBA+MOU decides (c2 flagged conflicting_sources). Either way the leave is advanced own leave, so it counts 0 paid weeks (R1d).

No employer-funded paid leave, top-up, childbirth benefit, disability plan or modified-duties provision appears in any saved document; every paid period is the faculty member's own (accrued or advanced) sick or vacation leave.

Not components: compulsory medical leave (CBA 21.8(d), Reg 1.201(11)) is imposed by the University, not taken by a parent; December personal leave days (CBA 21.11(b), Reg 1.201(22)) can be used only Dec 26-31; Reg 1.201(21) leave 'in furtherance of the mission of the University' is not a parent leave; sabbatical and professional development leave are research leaves; domestic violence, military, jury and workplace-injury leaves cannot be taken for a birth.

Calendar not recorded: the CBA defines a semester as 'approximately 19.5-week periods' (Art. 35; 14.7(b)), the appointment period, like the Wisconsin pay semester R8 excludes; no component is measured in terms, so the choice has no effect.

Chain, birth parent: parental leave up to 26 weeks (c1), with the advanced-leave Paid Parental Leave up to 12 weeks within it from the start (c2, own balance) and FMLA 12 workweeks alongside from the start (c3); then the optional one-year part-time leave (c4, consecutive_after c1). Additional medical leave (c6) and sick leave (c7, c8) are unlinked.
Chain, non-birth parent: the same: parental leave up to 26 weeks (c1) containing the Paid Parental Leave (c2) with FMLA alongside (c3), then the optional part-time leave (c4).

Documents cited but not saved: UF Sick Leave Pool policy; UF extended leave of absence policy and the Request for Extended Leave of Absence form; Paid Parental Leave Letter of Request; 29 CFR Part 825; UF Regulations 5.0761, 6.011, 7.003, 7.010, 7.025, 7.041, 7.048, 3.045, 3.046, 1.019; UF Modified Duty Program Policy (2006, workers' compensation); 'Guidelines and Information Regarding the Tenure, Permanent Status and Promotion Process'; college and department tenure criteria and bylaws.
